statements.text: Set the label attribute: it is the inner button's only accessible name and also its hover tooltip. Mark the slotted violet-icon decorative.

attributes.description: Visual emphasis variant for the button.
attributes.name: appearance

attributes.description: Accessible name used for the internal button label.
attributes.name: label

attributes.description: Native button type forwarded to the internal control.
attributes.name: type

slots.description: Icon or image content for the button.

examples.html: <violet-icon-button appearance="secondary" label="Settings" type="button"><violet-icon decorative icon="system/settings" label></violet-icon></violet-icon-button>
<violet-icon-button appearance="primary" label="Pin item" type="button"><violet-icon decorative icon="system/search" label></violet-icon></violet-icon-button>
<violet-icon-button appearance="quiet" disabled label="Archive item" type="button"><violet-icon decorative icon="system/search" label></violet-icon></violet-icon-button>

summary: Icon-only button for toolbar and utility actions; the default slot takes the icon and the label attribute names it.

usage.text: Unlike violet-button it forwards no aria-expanded, aria-pressed, aria-haspopup or aria-controls. For a toggle or popup trigger use violet-button with its ariaLabel property.
Not form-associated: type="submit" or "reset" does not submit or reset an enclosing form. Call form.requestSubmit() from a click listener.
Slot one violet-icon, svg or img; it is sized to fill the button's icon area. The default appearance is secondary.
